about.youAreOn: You are on v{{version}}. Open the latest release notes when you are ready to update.
about.motto: Your media. Your data.[[br]]On your terms.
about.lede: [[strong]]CrossWatch (CW)[[/strong]] is a synchronization engine that acts as a bridge to keep your [[strong]]AniList, BingeBase, CW local tracker, Emby, FlickList, Floppy, Jellyfin, Kitsu, Kodi, MDBList, Nuvio, Plex, PublicMetaDB, PunchPlay, Scrob, Silo, SIMKL, Stremio, Tautulli, TMDb, Tofa, Tracearr, Trakt and WeTrakr[[/strong]] in sync.
about.beta: [[strong]]Please note:[[/strong]] this software is still beta/experimental and may behave unpredictably. Make sure you have solid, tested backups before using it.
about.independent: CrossWatch is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Silo, Tofa, SIMKL, Floppy, FlickList, Trakt, AniList, TMDb, MDBList, Movie Paradise, PublicMetaDB, PunchPlay, BingeBase, Scrob, Tautulli, Tracearr, Kodi, Nuvio, Stremio, CW local tracker, or their owners.
about.anibridge: CrossWatch uses the AniBridge mappings dataset and the animeApi dataset for anime identifier and episode translation, with the CW Anime DB on top to fix verified mistakes.
about.names: Names, logos, trademarks, and brands belong to their respective owners and are used for identification only.
about.thirdParty: Third-party APIs and services have their own terms, rate limits, and account policies. Use CrossWatch responsibly and within those rules.
about.asIs: CrossWatch is provided as-is, without warranties. Keep backups of any state, tracker, cache, or configuration data you edit.
about.wikiSub: Setup guides, upgrade notes, and troubleshooting in one place.
about.communitySub: Join the discussions and get help from the community.
about.discordSub: Talk with other users and follow new releases.
